tools.name: ask_agent
tools.description: Sends a natural-language message to the backing A2A agent and returns its answer. To continue a multi-turn conversation, pass back the context_id (and task_id when the agent asked for more input) returned by the previous call.

message.description: The request, or the reply to the agent's question, in natural language.

context_id.description: context_id returned by a previous call. Pass it to continue that conversation; omit it to start a new one.

task_id.description: task_id returned by a previous call whose state was input-required or auth-required. Pass it with context_id to answer the agent's follow-up question.
